steps.question: Lesson 15: 22 Chip Leader vs Raise. What is your best action?

gradingSpecJson.responseIncorrect: There is a better line in this node.
gradingSpecJson.followUpContent: 22 as chip leader vs single raise. Call to set-mine or play position; price is reasonable. Calling is +EV—you're not committed to stacking off with a set, but you have implied odds. Core lesson: Small pairs want to see a cheap flop and hit a set. When the price is right (e.g. chip leader facing a single raise), call for implied odds—you're not committed to stacking off with just a pair, but a set can win a big pot. Don't overpay pre; if the raise is too big, fold.
